name: grounded-help-center
description: A bilingual (English/Turkish) help center with a grounded Q&A assistant: hybrid retrieval in PostgreSQL with pgvector, a code-level check on every answer, and infrastructure in AWS CDK.

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix infra
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix infra && npm test --prefix infra && npm run synth --prefix infra && npm run build && npm run check:public
